name: Dead engines
objective: Win the drift battle while the anomaly kills every drive.
brief: An anomaly in this cloud drains every drive in reach at times: for half a minute in every one and a half, no ship can make way. {enemy_name} raiders are drifting in it with you. Fight it out.
